observations.body: At Gethsemane Jesus takes disciples, grieves, prays three times about the cup and the Father’s will, finds them sleeping, and rises to meet the betrayer.
observations.label: Jesus prays while the disciples repeatedly sleep

observations.body: The passage places Gethsemane beside Watching, praying, sleeping, and rising.
